changelog: Build loopable welcome, product, FAQ, and close talking-head clips for an unattended night shift.

en.description: Turn one shop portrait and short welcome, product, FAQ, and close scripts into talking-avatar clips a store can loop overnight. This unattended live avatar and night-shift avatar studio can clone or pick a voice, then produce a talking avatar livestream set for welcome, product, FAQ, and close so an unattended livestream or digital human livestream can keep a shop loop presenter on camera. Use it for overnight digital human clips, live room avatar loops, and a night-shift talking-head that keeps the room open.
en.summary: Turn one shop portrait and short welcome, product, FAQ, and close scripts into talking-avatar clips a store can loop overnight.
en.title: Unattended Live Avatar: Night-Shift Talking-Head Clips
